title: Racial Demographics in Sarasota County Over Time
text:
This animated map explores changes in the spatial distribution of the Black population across Sarasota County, Florida across the 2000, 2010, and 2020 Decennial Censuses.
Throughout all three decades, the Black population has remained heavily concentrated in North Sarasota (Newtown), while the vast majority of other tracts across the county have remained under 2% Black.
